Each page follows the same pattern: the problem in my own words, a formalisation in relational algebra (tables as multisets of tuples, `WHERE` as selection, `SELECT` as projection, joins as filtered Cartesian products), the SQL, and the pitfalls I hit along the way. Use the categories to find every problem that uses a given pattern.
